title: Odometer Reading on a Traded-Vehicle Refund — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
For a traded-vehicle refund on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the unused mileage share is measured at a reading. The reading is the first of the following that applies:
- **Kessler Care cancellation odometer.** Consider the latest refund calculated on a cancellation for the vehicle being sold or traded, of the Kessler Care plan sold on the contract's purchase deal. That plan is a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan; a contract sold on its own has no such plan. Where that calculation records an odometer above the certified one, the reading is that odometer.
- **Latest group repair order.** Where none does, consider the latest repair order a group store wrote for the vehicle. It is the one whose labor was closed last; where two closed labor on the same day, the one listed first in the service records of Service Accounts and Repair Orders. Where it records an odometer above the certified one, the reading is that repair-order odometer.
- **Otherwise,** the certified odometer.

| Certified odometer (hypothetical) | Kessler Care sold-or-traded refund calculation odometer | Latest group repair order odometer | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|
| 71250 | 71600 | 71900 | 71600 |
| 71250 | 71250 | 71900 | 71900 |
| 71250 | none | 70980 | 71250 |
